summary: Comprehensive testing of Advanced Mock Test System completed successfully. All backend APIs (18/18 tests passed) and frontend UI features working correctly. Tested BITSAT, VITEEE, SRMJEEE, and AEEE mock test routes with full quiz functionality including instructions page, quiz interface, question navigation, answer selection, marking for review, timer, submit modal, and results page.
passed_tests: Homepage displays all 5 mock tests (skilltest, bitsat, viteee, srmjeee, aeee) with Take Test buttons
Navigate to /test/bitsat - instructions page loads correctly
Instructions page shows test overview (3 hours, 130 questions, 390 max marks, 5 sections)
Sections breakdown table displays all 5 sections with correct question counts
Marking scheme shows +3 correct, -1 wrong, 0 unattempted
Question palette legend shows all 5 status types
Begin Test button starts the quiz and loads questions from API
Quiz screen shows question text with 4 options (A, B, C, D)
Selecting an option highlights it with checkmark icon
Question palette shows answered/not answered/marked status correctly
Save & Next button moves to next question and saves answer
Mark & Next button marks question for review and moves to next
Clear button removes selected answer
Section tabs show progress (X/Y answered) and allow navigation between sections
Timer counts down from 3:00:00 (180 minutes)
Previous/Next navigation buttons work correctly
Submit Test button shows confirmation modal with statistics
Submit modal shows total questions, answered, not answered, not visited, marked for review
Submitting test shows results page with score, percentage, accuracy
Results page shows section-wise breakdown with correct/wrong/marks
Performance analysis shows accuracy bar, attempt rate, avg time per question
Back to Home and Retake Test buttons work correctly
Theme toggle switches between dark and light mode
/test/viteee route loads VITEEE mock test (125 questions, 2.5 hours, 4 sections)
/test/srmjeee route loads SRMJEEE mock test (125 questions, 2.5 hours, 5 sections)
/test/aeee route loads AEEE mock test (100 questions, 2 hours, 3 sections)
Mobile responsive design works correctly on 390x844 viewport
Backend API: Root endpoint responds correctly
Backend API: Quiz sections returns all 5 sections with correct config
Backend API: All questions endpoint returns 130 questions across 5 sections
Backend API: Individual section endpoints return correct question counts
Backend API: Quiz submission calculates scores correctly with negative marking
Backend API: Correct answers endpoint returns all answers in valid format
seed_data_creation: None - questions are hardcoded in server.py
context_for_next_testing_agent: Advanced Mock Test System fully tested. All 4 test routes (bitsat, viteee, srmjeee, aeee) use the AdvancedMockTest component at /test/{testId}. The skilltest route uses a separate EmployeeSkillTest component. Backend APIs at /api/quiz/* handle questions and submissions. All features including timer, section navigation, question palette, marking for review, and results display are working correctly.
